name: Lambholt
description: A small farming village in Kessig with a palisade, an inn and a stone town hall, the birthplace of Vadrik's husband.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, races toward the besieged town of Lambholt smelling angel's blood.
timeline.quote: The aroma met Arlinn's wide wolf nostrils as she raced up the sheer incline of a gorge toward the town of Lambholt under siege.

timeline.summary: Arlinn witnessed a mad angel's descent on Lambholt, which left cathars and civilians slain.
timeline.quote: She had witnessed the mad angel's descent on Lambholt from afar

relations.note: Lambholt lies in the farmlands carved from the Ulvenwald.
relations.quote: through the farmlands that brave souls had carved out from the Ulvenwald.

pages_say.description: A town under siege by a mad angel.
A small farming village in Kessig with a palisade, an inn and a stone town hall, the birthplace of Vadrik's husband.
